narrative: 神话、片头字幕、一种精巧的威胁：可见的折痕、硬质的影棚光或阳光，边缘锐利。一个活生生的身影可以本身就是纸，也可以置身于折痕之中。
一个人手里拿着一只纸鹤道具，那只是手工课的花絮，而不是这个风格。对于一张泥泞的战争静帧，它是错误的工具；如果画面质感是没有折面的撕裂纤维，也是错误的用法。
how: 平视高度，35mm到50mm焦段，固定机位。硬质的影棚光或阳光。
可见的折痕、平面化的色彩、被折叠出来的生物或城市。保持边缘锐利。
纸上不要出现文字。Prompt: Origami world of [Subject], lawful creases, planar color, a person or city becoming a fold.
when: 神话、片头字幕、一种精巧的折纸式威胁。不要把它当作真实房间里的手工纸鹤来用，也不要用没有折痕的撕裂纸浆。
vs: 纸艺风（Paper）是撕裂的质感和纤维。微缩模型（Diorama）是微缩的空间。
折纸风则是折痕的法则：平面化的折面，一个可以折叠的世界。如果你看到的是撕裂而没有折面，你想要的是纸艺风。
examples_film: 《久保与二弦琴》（Kubo and the Two Strings）把折纸当作有生命的材质来处理。定格动画中的纸艺和片头设计，是折痕即线条这一理念最广为人知的应用。
这是折叠的语法，而不是要照搬的手工静帧。
mistakes: 一个人手里拿着纸鹤，或滑向了纸艺风的撕裂质感。破绽是手工课花絮感。
修正方法：整个世界就是那个折叠，遵循法则的折痕，平面化的色彩。

faq.q: 电影中的折纸风（Origami）是什么？
faq.a: 把纸当作雕塑：遵循法则的折痕、平面化的色彩，一个人或一座城市变成一次折叠。整个世界都在折叠。一只道具纸鹤不等于这个风格。

faq.q: 折纸风（Origami）与纸艺风（Paper）的区别
faq.a: 纸艺风是纸浆、撕裂、纤维、剪影。折纸风则是折痕和折面。撕裂对折叠。
神话、片头字幕、精巧的威胁。跳过泥泞的战争静帧和手工课花絮。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写折纸风的提示词？
faq.a: 先写硬质光线，然后要求出现折痕。禁止只用一只手持纸鹤来充当纸这个元素。

narrative: Myths, titles, a delicate threat: visible creases, hard studio or sun, edges sharp. A living figure can be paper or stand among folds.
A person holding a paper crane as a prop is a craft-table extra, not the look. It is the wrong tool for a muddy war still, and the wrong tool if the stock is torn fiber with no facets.
how: Eye height, 35mm to 50mm, lock-off. Hard studio or sun.
Visible creases, planar color, folded creature or city. Keep edges sharp.
No letters on the paper. Prompt: Origami world of [Subject], lawful creases, planar color, a person or city becoming a fold.
when: Myths, titles, a delicate folded threat. Do not use it as a craft-table crane in a real room, and do not use torn pulp without folds.
vs: Paper is torn stock and fibers. Diorama is miniature space.
Origami is crease law: planar facets, a world that folds. If you can see a tear and no facet, you wanted paper.
examples_film: Kubo and the Two Strings treats folded paper as living matter. Stop-motion paper and title design are the well-known uses of crease as line.
Grammar of the fold, not a craft still to copy.
mistakes: A person holding a paper crane, or a slide into Paper tears. The tell is a craft extra.
Fix it: the world is the fold, lawful creases, planar color.

faq.a: Paper as sculpture: lawful creases, planar color, a person or city becoming a fold. The world folds. A prop crane is not the look.
Paper is pulp, tear, fiber, cut-out. Origami is crease and facet. Tear versus fold.
Myths, titles, delicate threat. Skip muddy war stills and craft-table extras.

faq.q: How do I prompt Origami for AI image or video?
faq.a: Hard light, then: Origami world of [Subject], lawful creases, planar color, a person or city becoming a fold. Demand creases. Forbid a handheld crane as the only paper.
